semiconductor_relevance: Medium — YODN Lighting Corp. provides specialized light sources for automation inspection and semiconductor packaging, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: YODN Lighting Corp. specializes in the development and manufacturing of advanced light sources and components used in automation inspection and semiconductor packaging. Their product offerings include a range of LED light source boxes and coaxial and linear light sources, which are essential for precise inspection and packaging tasks in semiconductor production.
